uniswap_v3.summary: Uniswap v3 separates stateless periphery routers and position managers from immutable singleton factory and deterministic CREATE2 concentrated liquidity pool contracts.

edges.description: Resolves pool address via deterministic factory computeAddress bytecode hash.
Executes swap() with uniswapV3SwapCallback verification.
Deploys pool contract via CREATE2 with salt keccak256(token0, token1, fee).
Mints liquidity ticks and collects token0/token1 fees on behalf of position owner.
Simulates swap execution and catches revert payload containing exact amountOut.

pancakeswap_v2.summary: PancakeSwap v2 pairs an immutable routing contract with a factory contract controlling deterministic constant-product pair deployments and liquidity mining reward vaults.

edges.description: Direct reference to factory immutable address for pair resolution.
Executes swap() and transfers user tokens to pair reserves.
Deploys pair bytecode via CREATE2 with salt keccak256(tokenA, tokenB).
Mints block reward CAKE emissions distributed to LP stakers.
Accepts deposit and withdrawal of Cake-LP tokens into farming pool.

aave_v3.summary: Aave v3 uses an immutable AddressesProvider registry to resolve and coordinate an InitializableImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy pool with ACL roles, debt configurators, oracles, and dynamic token derivative contracts.

aave_pool_impl.name: Aave v3 Pool Logic Implementation
aave_pool_impl.role: Lending, Borrowing, Liquidation, Flash Loan Logic

a_usdc_v3.name: Aave v3 aUSDC Interest Bearing Token

edges.description: Forwards all incoming external calls to logic implementation via DELEGATECALL.
Immutable pointer binds pool instance to canonical AddressesProvider registry.
Configures active reserves, borrow caps, supply caps, and interest rate strategies.
Points to ACL manager enforcing POOL_ADMIN and EMERGENCY_ADMIN authorizations.
Queries asset valuations for health factor computations.
Mints and burns aTokens dynamically upon user supply and withdraw.

safe_l2.systemName: Gnosis Safe Multi-Contract Smart Account Architecture
safe_l2.summary: Safe utilizes a lightweight minimal proxy factory that clones gas-efficient master copies, delegating batch executions, EIP-1271 signature verifications, and module expansions to specialized libraries.

compatibility_fallback.name: CompatibilityFallbackHandler v1.3.0
compatibility_fallback.role: EIP-1271 Signature Validation & Token Receiver Handler

edges.description: Deploys proxy clones referencing safe_l2_master_copy address in slot 0.
Routes unmatched calldata (e.g. isValidSignature EIP-1271) to fallback handler.
Executes atomic batched multi-transactions in caller storage context.
Delegates on-chain message signature events.

arbitrum_inbox.systemName: Arbitrum One Rollup Bridge & Cross-Domain Messaging Architecture
arbitrum_inbox.summary: Arbitrum utilizes a multi-tiered bridge architecture where the Delayed Inbox receives and sequences L1-to-L2 user messages into an escrow Bridge, which the SequencerInbox and RollupCore commit and finalize via interactive fraud provers and Outbox execution.

arb_inbox_impl.name: Arbitrum Inbox Implementation
arb_inbox_impl.role: Message Serialization, Ticket Creation, Retryable Tickets

arb_sequencer_inbox.name: Arbitrum SequencerInbox
arb_sequencer_inbox.role: Sequencer Batch Accumulator & Fast Path Committer

arb_rollup_core.name: Arbitrum RollupCore Proxy
arb_rollup_core.role: Dispute Resolution, RBlock Assertions, State Roots

edges.description: Forwards user deposit and message execution to Inbox logic.
Controls upgradeTo and upgradeToAndCall under timelock governance.
Enqueues delayed messages and deposits ETH/assets into bridge escrow.
Appends fast-path sequencer message batches to bridge accumulator.
Verifies batch availability and confirms state transitions.
Requests bridge to release escrowed funds for finalized L2-to-L1 withdrawals.
